questions.question: Where did the Indus Valley Civilization develop?
questions.answer: Along the Indus River and its tributaries.

questions.question: The Indus Valley Civilization was one of the world's earliest civilizations.
Which city belonged to the Indus Valley Civilization?
Fill in the blank: Another famous city of the Indus Valley Civilization was ______.
What was the main river of the Indus Valley Civilization?
Observe the image and identify the ancient city.
Which image represents the Great Bath?
The cities of the Indus Valley Civilization had well-planned streets.
Fill in the blank: Houses in the Indus Valley Civilization were commonly made of ______ bricks.
Which feature is the Indus Valley Civilization especially famous for?
What was the Great Bath used for?
questions.answer: It was probably used for religious ceremonies and bathing.

questions.question: The Indus Valley Civilization had an advanced drainage system.
Observe the image and identify the object.
Which image shows Harappa?
Explain why the Indus Valley Civilization is called an urban civilization.
questions.answer: Because it had well-planned cities with roads, drainage systems, public buildings, and organized settlements.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The script of the Indus Valley Civilization has not yet been ______.
Most houses in the Indus Valley Civilization had access to drainage facilities.
Which of the following was an important public building in Mohenjo-daro?
Why was the Indus River important to the civilization?
questions.answer: It provided water, fertile land for farming, and supported trade and transportation.

questions.question: Explain three important features of the Indus Valley Civilization.
questions.answer: The civilization had planned cities, advanced drainage systems, standardized bricks, and important cities such as Harappa and Mohenjo-daro.
